title: dispatch's turn cap for a code task that creates a module or edits bl_land.py fits the work
goal: dispatch's default --max-turns for a task reflects its size (a new module with tests and docs, or an edit of a large module such as bl_land.py), so a task worker does not stop at the cap with its work uncommitted; in SP-dqkf3i42 TK-g4c5kxsc stopped at 60 turns with staged gates and was resumed, and every later task was dispatched at 100 by hand (TK-mialzcmq used 102, TK-g67asvm5 122 over two passes)
